description: AppShell nav refactor + all low/medium-risk page restyling. Depends on FEAT-001 (CSS classes must exist). Rewrites AppShell from sidebar to horizontal sticky nav with mobile hamburger. Restyling covers: LoginPage, RegisterPage, SignatureModal, RecordEntryForm, RecordDetailPage, LogDetailPage, LogsPage, AuditPage, UsersPage, PersonnelPage, LogBuilderPage, DashboardPage. These files are independent of each other — all can be implemented in a single FEAT because the pattern is the same across them (class renames, lbl deletion, border-radius removal). RecordsPage (inline expand panel) is deferred to FEAT-003 due to its higher complexity.
steps: Rewrite src/shared/components/AppShell.tsx. Remove old imports: LayoutDashboard, FileText, ClipboardList, Users, UserCheck, Building2, LogOut from lucide-react. Keep: BookOpen from lucide-react. Add: useState from react. Keep: NavLink, useNavigate from react-router-dom. Keep: useAuth from ../../auth/AuthContext. Define NAV_ITEMS constant (flat array, no sections): [{ to: '/', label: 'Dashboard', end: true }, { to: '/logs', label: 'Logs', end: false }, { to: '/relationships', label: 'Relationships', end: false }, { to: '/personnel', label: 'Personnel', end: false }, { to: '/users', label: 'Users', end: false }, { to: '/audit', label: 'Audit Trail', end: false }]. Add mobileOpen: boolean state via useState(false). Render: outer div (minHeight 100vh, flex, flexDirection column) containing: (a) mobile-nav-overlay div with open class conditional, onClick setMobileOpen(false); (b) nav.nav with nav-container div containing nav-brand div (BookOpen icon 26x26 gradient square + wordmark span), nav-links div with conditional mobile-open class mapping NAV_ITEMS to NavLink components each with onClick setMobileOpen(false), and nav-right div with nav-user-chip span for user email + nav-logout button + mobile-menu-toggle button with hamburger span; (c) main.main-content with children. Remove old app-shell/sidebar/main-area structure entirely.

Add .auth-card-header with gradient icon square (26x26, borderRadius 3, gradient from var(--brand) to var(--accent)) + BookOpen icon (size 13, white) + wordmark span (LogbookBuilder). Body in .auth-card-body: h1.auth-title text 'SIGN IN TO YOUR WORKSPACE', p.auth-subtitle 'Enter your credentials to continue'. Replace lb-wordmark/lb-wordmark-primary/lb-wordmark-secondary classes with .wordmark and .wordmark span. Remove the floating .auth-logo div above the card. Submit button gets width: '100%' style. Form logic unchanged.

Apply same auth-card structure to src/auth/RegisterPage.tsx. Same lb-wordmark → wordmark replacement, same card-header with icon, same auth-card-body with appropriate title/subtitle. Form fields and submission logic unchanged.
